name: StoryScan
description: A stunning web-based disk analyzer for Unraid that transforms storage exploration into a visual experience. Interactive treemaps, powerful search and filtering, top 10 space hogs, directory comparison, historical size tracking, and dark mode support. Finally, a disk analyzer that's as beautiful as it is functional.

paths.name: File Path
paths.description: Host path to scan. Map your Unraid share(s) here.

paths.name: Database Storage
paths.description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (historical scan data). Map to a location on your Unraid server to preserve history across container updates.

variables.name: SCAN_DIRECTORIES
variables.description: Comma-separated list of directories inside the container to scan.

variables.name: SCAN_CRON_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable automatic background scanning on a schedule. Set to false to disable.

variables.name: SCAN_INTERVAL_HOURS
variables.description: Hours between automatic scans. Accepts decimals (0.5 = 30 min). Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: SCAN_ON_START
variables.description: Run an initial scan immediately when the container starts.

variables.name: SCAN_CRON_EXPRESSION
variables.description: Optional: override with a custom cron expression (e.g. '0 3 * * *' for 3am daily). Leave empty to use SCAN_INTERVAL_HOURS.

variables.name: TREEMAP_MAX_NODES
variables.description: Maximum number of items to render in the treemap.

variables.name: TREEMAP_MAX_DEPTH
variables.description: Maximum folder depth to display in the treemap.

variables.name: TREEMAP_LIGHT_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Item count below which no filtering is applied.

variables.name: TREEMAP_MODERATE_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Item count threshold for moderate filtering.

variables.name: TREEMAP_AGGRESSIVE_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Item count threshold for aggressive filtering.
